title: GenFair: Systematic Test Generation for Fairness Fault Detection in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting, removing, or negating gender attributes in test prompts using metamorphic relations and comparing the tone of LLM responses to detect inconsistencies.
Replacing ethnicity attributes in test cases using equivalence partitioning and measuring tone inconsistencies in model outputs using a fine-tuned BERT emotion classifier.
Applying boundary value analysis and mutation operators to age attributes (e.g., old vs. young) in test cases and assessing shifts in LLM response tone.
Modifying social status and economic condition attributes (e.g., low-income vs. high-income) in prompts and checking for tone disparities across outputs.
Substituting religious identities in generated test cases to evaluate behavioral consistency in the tone of model responses.
Varying political views in test prompts and applying metamorphic testing to detect fairness violations via tone analysis.
Changing spoken languages in test case scenarios and comparing LLM response tones to detect behavioral inconsistencies.
Mutating marital status and family-related attributes (e.g., number of children) to evaluate tone consistency in model responses.
Replacing occupational attributes in prompts and using metamorphic testing to evaluate response tone fairness.
